title: Keep app windows on the app's own pages and tighten the content policy
seam: src-tauri/src/ (app window set-up) and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (the security block)
story: Maestro's windows now refuse to load any page that is not one of the app's own, and the app's content rules forbid a few page features it never uses. Nothing looks or works differently in normal use: the main window, the issue map, the Work Journal and the Workshop report open as before.
no_qa_reason: Nothing a user can see in normal use; the guard only acts when a window tries to leave the app's own pages. Unit tests cover the decision and a start-up test of a real build passed before the merge.
